CRUD operations for GoalProject records via agent-os CLI

## Usage

```bash

agent-os goal-project update --id <value> [--goalId <value>] [--projectId <value>] [--entityId <value>]

```

### List all goalProject records

```bash

```

### Create a goalProject

